title: Build the Lapsed Customer Return Queue Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/inactive-customer-winback.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit.
Kit contents: Lapsed Customer Winback Setup Checklist; Skip-Rules-First Prompt; VIP-First Draft Prompt; Return Check Prompt; Lapse, VIP, and Offer Worksheet; Contact Log Template; Send Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Customer Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Lapsed Customer Return Queue', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a customer table with exactly 8 data rows whose names are J. Rivera, L. Park, T. Brooks, A. Chen, M. Ortiz, K. Singh, S. Diaz, and R. Wells, and shows '2026-06-15', '2026-04-16', '8', '10% off next color', and 'complimentary consult'.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'SKIP RULES FIRST'. A. Chen is SKIPPED with text containing '2026-06-01' and the exact sentence 'Do not queue someone whose last visit is after your lapse date.'. M. Ortiz is SKIPPED with text containing 'marketing_consent' and 'no'. K. Singh is SKIPPED with text containing 'do_not_contact' and 'yes'. S. Diaz is SKIPPED with text containing 'one-time' or '1'. R. Wells is SKIPPED with text containing 'already contacted'.

Step 3 shows the queue ordered J. Rivera, then L. Park, then T. Brooks. It shows the draft 'It has been a while since your Cut & color on Feb 3. If useful, a 10% off next color is available.' It shows T. Brooks draft text containing 'Massage', 'Mar 1' or 'March 1', and 'complimentary consult'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. CONFIRMED for J. Rivera contains '2026-02-03', 'Cut & color', '11', and 'yes'. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'days since visit' and 'do not prove why'.

Step 4 shows the J. Rivera CONFIRMED line. Activating 'Check facts against the export row' reveals three rows (last visit, last service, offer), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values 2026-02-03, Cut & color, and 10% off next color.

Step 5 shows J. Rivera RETURNED with last visit 2026-07-01, L. Park still lapsed, T. Brooks still lapsed, and the exact sentences 'A return is not proof the message caused it.' and 'Confirm consent before any message.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' and 'Do not invent a discount that is not on your offer list.' and a link to /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every customer name, visit date, service, consent value, offer, skip reason, draft, and return outcome in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input and sample_output exactly.

Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. Neither page contains a dollar amount. The only percentage allowed is the fictional offer-list phrase '10% off next color'.
Neither page contains a recovery-rate figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback'.
GET /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit.

Lapsed Customer Return Queue is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'inactive-customer-winback', title 'Lapsed Customer Return Queue', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'inactive-customer-winback') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Lapsed Customer Return Queue Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Lapsed Customer Return Queue entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 9 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Skip-Rules-First Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIP RULES FIRST', 'marketing_consent', 'do_not_contact', 'already contacted', 'Do not queue someone whose last visit is after your lapse date', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send'.
The VIP-First Draft Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'only after', 'skip', 'VIP', 'occasional', 'written offer', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'You send it'.
The Return Check Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'RETURNED', 'still lapsed', 'A return is not proof the message caused it', 'Do not invent', 'contact log'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Lapse, VIP, and Offer Worksheet has a visible label 'Lapse if last visit before' whose default value is '2026-04-16', a visible label 'VIP if visits in 12 months at least' whose default value is '8', a visible label 'Skip one-time buyers' whose default is checked or yes, a visible label 'VIP offers (one per line)' whose default includes '10% off next color', a visible label 'Occasional offers (one per line)' whose default includes 'complimentary consult', plus a 'Generate My Winback Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Apply SKIP RULES FIRST before any draft.', 'Skip when marketing_consent is no or missing.', 'Skip when do_not_contact is yes.', 'Skip when already contacted this period.', 'Lapse if last visit before 2026-04-16.', 'VIP if visits_12mo >= 8.', 'Skip one-time buyers.', 'VIP offers: 10% off next color.', 'Occasional offers: complimentary consult.', and 'Do not send. You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' The block has a Copy button.
If the lapse-date field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a lapse threshold date.' and generates no rules block.
If the VIP floor field is empty, 0, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a VIP visit floor of 1 or more.' and generates no rules block.
If both VIP offers and occasional offers are empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter at least one offer on your written offer list.' and generates no rules block.

When 'VIP offers (one per line)' contains only '10% off next color' and 'Occasional offers (one per line)' contains 'complimentary consult' and 'free add-on' on two lines, the generated rules block contains 'VIP offers: 10% off next color.' and 'Occasional offers: complimentary consult; free add-on.'.

The Contact Log Template shows the columns as_of, first, last_visit, last_service, visits_12mo, segment, offer_used, action, outcome. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'as_of,first,last_visit,last_service,visits_12mo,segment,offer_used,action,outcome' and whose J. Rivera row contains '2026-06-15', 'Cut & color', 'VIP', 'drafted_not_sent' or 'returned'.

The Send Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Customer Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the first,last_visit,last_service,visits_12mo,marketing_consent,do_not_contact rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Lapsed Customer Return Queue card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Lapsed Customer Return Queue entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Lapsed Customer Return Queue card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, AI Expense Watchdog, No-show Recovery Assistant, Unbilled Work Review Queue, On-brand Reply Review Queue, Stalled Deal Rescue Queue, Next-Pay Labor Check, Quiet Proposal Chase Queue, and Shift Coverage vs Demand Check entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/, components/premium/inactive-customer-winback/, and src/lib/premium/inactive-customer-winback/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/inactive-customer-winback/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/inactive-customer-winback/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
